case.summary: Case HHG-003 was triggered when customer C08623 reported an unauthorized $49.00 in-person transaction (ID 3530164) on card C08623-K2. Analysis identified an episode of two transactions totaling $108.00 in region 330 between 2016-12-09 12:36:58 and 2016-12-10 13:01:21 for product W. Card-present activity in region 330 accounts for only 4.3% of prior activity while home activity continued in parallel, supporting a fraud probability of 0.95. The verdict is confirmed fraud under the out_of_region_use pattern, and actions to block the card and create a case were maintained.
